main_text.p: recordatio. Quâ verè se Paulum ostendit, Hebr. xiii. 18. πεποιθαμεν γὰρ ὅτι καλὴν συνείδησιν ἔχομεν· ἐν πᾶσι καλῶς θέλοντες ἀναστρέφεσθαι. Primò quidem, is mos est Pauli singularis. Ita 11. Corinth. i. 12. & συνειδήσεως ἐν ἁπλότητι καὶ εἰλικρινείᾳ, & ἀναστροφῆς suæ testimonium ostentat. Ita Actor. xxiii. 1. πάσῃ συνειδήσει ἀγαθῇ, πεπολίτευμαι τῷ Θεῷ. Prætereà, Paulo singularis quædam ratio, conscientiæ suæ hoc in loco in testem adhibendæ. Audiebat apud Judæos, quasi διὰ σχῶν ἀπολογίαν τῶν νόμων. Hinc Judæorum in illum invidia, exacerbatio, contumeliæ. Purgat se ergò hunc in modum, & ad conscientiam provocat, Oecumenio, paraphraste; ἐν ἀπολογίαν τῶν νόμων κηρύσσομεν, καθὼς ἔνεστι διαβάλλουσιν, ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ τῆς γενέμα-τῶν καὶ τῆς σχέσεως, ἀπὸ τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν μετέχομεν. Sic etiam Theodoretus Commentario ad locum. Malè audiebat apud eos, ut qui legi contraria prædicaret. Ergò docet se nullâ aliâ causâ id facere, quàm ut pareat verbo divino. page.notes: Greek text in the second half of the page is set in a small, cursive-looking type and is partly difficult to read; the readings of the Oecumenius passage ("ἀπολογίαν", "γενέμα-", "σχέσεως") and of the Acts quotation ("πάσῃ") are doubtful and should be checked against the scan. The word-break "γενέμα-" is taken as printed. Scripture references are copied as printed (Hebr. xiii. 18; 11. Corinth. i. 12; Actor. xxiii. 1). The catchword "stimo-" is the start of the next page, printed at the bottom right. The page number 204 and running head are printed at the top.
